description: VN 'về nhà / ra đó' transfer: learners overgeneralize 'to' before adverbial destinations ('go to home', 'went to there'). Rule en-vietlish-go-home drops 'to' before a CLOSED bare-adverb whitelist (home/there/abroad/downtown/upstairs/downstairs). The pattern has no 'the', so the building sense 'go to the home (for the elderly)' is left untouched; it does not collide with en-step5-preposition-pattern ('go school'->'go to school').
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. 'go to <noun place>' is correct (go to school/work). V1 drops 'to' only before the closed bare-adverb whitelist. Negatives lock: already-correct 'I go home', the building sense 'go to the home for the elderly', a non-whitelisted noun place 'go to school', 'go to work', and a he/she routine 'goes to school' (proves no interaction with en-step5-preposition-pattern).

positive.input: I want to go to home
positive.notes: Infinitive 'to go to home': only the second 'to' (before home) is dropped.
Past 'went to there' + whitelisted adverb 'there' -> went there.

negative.input: I go to the home for the elderly
negative.expectedCorrection: I go to the home for the elderly.
negative.notes: 'go to the home' = the building sense; pattern has no 'the' so it must abstain. (Precision lock.)
'school' is a noun place, not in the adverb whitelist; correct as-is -> must not fire.
'work' not whitelisted; 'go to work' is correct -> must abstain.

negative.input: He goes to school every day
negative.expectedCorrection: He goes to school every day.
negative.notes: Proves no interaction with en-step5-preposition-pattern ('go school'->'go to school' is the opposite direction); must abstain.
